anomalies.expected: The specification states C12 is the 2.2 µF input capacitor (CIN) of the FAN53610AUC33X buck regulator, matching the datasheet's recommended 2.2 µF CIN. A 2.2 nF value is 1000× too small for this position.

evidence.quote: EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch: 'C12 2.2nF' tied from BAT+ to GND at IC1 input
'C12 (2.2 µF) on BAT+→GND is the input cap; C13 (10 µF) on +3V3→GND is the output cap — these exactly match the FAN53610 datasheet's recommended 2.2 µF CIN / 10 µF COUT values'

anomalies.impact: With only 2.2 nF of input capacitance, the 1 A synchronous buck has effectively no high-frequency input bypass. The BAT+ rail will exhibit large switching ripple, the regulator may become unstable or fail to start/hold regulation under load, EMI will increase, and the +3V3 rail (feeding the SKW92A, keyboard, microSD and EPD switch) is at risk of brown-out.

No other deviation is supported by the drawing with comparable confidence.
